test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System continuously monitors temperature in GMP storage areas and records readings at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all GMP storage areas.
System is powered on and operational.

test_steps.action: Observe the EMS interface and verify that temperature readings are being displayed for all configured GMP storage areas.
test_steps.expected_result: Live temperature readings are visible for all GMP storage areas.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of EMS interface showing live readings

test_steps.action: Access the historical data log for a specific GMP storage area and examine the timestamps of consecutive temperature readings.
test_steps.expected_result: The time difference between any two consecutive temperature readings does not exceed 5 minutes.
data_to_capture: Exported data log for a selected storage area
Analysis of timestamps to confirm interval compliance

acceptance_criteria: All GMP storage areas display continuous temperature readings.
Recorded temperature data shows intervals of 5 minutes or less between readings.
data_integrity_requirements: Data is recorded accurately and without loss.
Timestamps are correct and reflect actual measurement times.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range, Accuracy, and Alarm Deviation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS operates within the specified temperature range (-80°C to +50°C) with the required accuracy (±0.5°C) and generates alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all GMP storage areas.
System is powered on and operational.
Known temperature sources or calibrated reference thermometers are available.

test_steps.action: Using a calibrated reference thermometer, measure the temperature in a GMP storage area and compare it to the EMS reading for the same area.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS temperature reading is within ±0.5°C of the reference thermometer reading.

test_steps.action: Adjust the setpoint for a GMP storage area and then introduce a controlled temperature change to simulate a deviation of +2°C from the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification within 30 seconds of the temperature exceeding the ±2°C deviation from the setpoint.

test_steps.action: Introduce a controlled temperature change to simulate a deviation of -2°C from the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification within 30 seconds of the temperature falling below the ±2°C deviation from the setpoint.

acceptance_criteria: Temperature readings are accurate within ±0.5°C of a calibrated reference.
Alerts are generated within 30 seconds for temperature deviations of ±2°C from the setpoint.
data_integrity_requirements: Temperature readings are accurate and reliable.
Alarm triggers are timely and correctly recorded.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor Software Unmodified and Data Storage Format
test_cases.objective: To verify that the vendor-supplied software is used without modification and that all data is stored in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Access to system logs and database configuration.

test_steps.action: Review system installation and configuration documentation to confirm no modifications were made to the vendor-supplied software.
test_steps.expected_result: Documentation confirms that the vendor-supplied software has not been modified.
data_to_capture: Installation and configuration documentation review notes.

test_steps.action: Access the EMS database and examine the format of stored temperature and humidity data.
test_steps.expected_result: Stored data is in the vendor's standard database format as specified in the vendor documentation.

acceptance_criteria: The vendor-supplied software is confirmed to be unmodified.
Stored data is verified to be in the vendor's standard database format.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in a format that ensures its integrity and is retrievable.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Audit Trail and Electronic Signature Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system maintains an audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11 and utilizes the vendor's built-in functionality for electronic signatures.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions for testing audit trails and electronic signatures.
Access to system logs and audit trail reports.

test_steps.action: Perform a simulated temperature deviation that triggers an alert. Observe and record the audit trail entries generated for this event.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail logs the date, time, user (if applicable), action performed (e.g., temperature deviation detected), and any system response.
data_to_capture: Audit trail log entries for the simulated event.

test_steps.action: Initiate a process that requires an electronic signature (e.g., acknowledging an alarm, approving a report). Verify that the system prompts for and captures a valid electronic signature using the vendor's built-in functionality.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts for an electronic signature, captures the required elements (e.g., username, password, timestamp), and the signature is validated by the vendor's functionality.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of the electronic signature prompt and capture.

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail to confirm that the electronic signature event is logged with all required 21 CFR Part 11 attributes.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail accurately records the electronic signature event, including the signer's identity, date, time, and the reason for the signature.
data_to_capture: Audit trail log entries for the electronic signature event.

acceptance_criteria: All significant events, including alarm triggers and electronic signature actions, are logged in the audit trail.
The audit trail contains all required 21 CFR Part 11 attributes.
Electronic signatures are captured using the vendor's built-in functionality and are correctly associated with events.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must be secure, unalterable, and time-stamped.
Electronic signatures must be legally binding and attributable to a specific individual.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Report Usage for Batch Release and Data Archival
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system utilizes vendor-provided standard reports for batch release and that data archival functions correctly for the required retention period.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists to test archival functionality.
Access to system administration and reporting modules.

test_steps.action: Access the reporting module of the EMS and generate a standard report for a specific batch/period, as would be used for batch release.
test_steps.expected_result: A standard report is generated successfully, containing accurate temperature and humidity data for the selected period.

test_steps.action: Initiate the data archival process for data older than a specified period (e.g., 6 years) using the vendor's archival feature.
test_steps.expected_result: The archival process completes successfully, and the specified historical data is moved to the archival storage.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of data moved to archive

test_steps.action: Attempt to access or retrieve data that has been archived to verify its integrity and accessibility.
test_steps.expected_result: Archived data is retrievable and remains intact, demonstrating successful archival.

acceptance_criteria: Standard reports generated by the system are suitable for batch release purposes.
Data archival process successfully moves historical data to archival storage.
Archived data is retrievable and maintains its integrity.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be accurate and complete in standard reports.
Archived data must be retained securely and be retrievable.
urs_requirements: URS-EMS-007: Standard reports provided by vendor shall be used for batch release.
URS-EMS-010: Data shall be retained for 7 years using vendor's archival feature.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Alarm Notification Integration with Site Paging System
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS alarm notifications are successfully integrated with the site paging system using the vendor API.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Site paging system is operational and accessible.
Vendor API for alarm notification is configured and enabled.
Contact information for the site paging system is correctly entered in the EMS.

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature deviation that triggers an alarm condition within the EMS (e.g., by temporarily altering a sensor's environment or simulating a fault).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alarm notification for the induced temperature deviation.

test_steps.action: Observe the site paging system for incoming notifications triggered by the EMS alarm.
test_steps.expected_result: The site paging system receives an alarm notification originating from the EMS, containing relevant alarm details (e.g., location, temperature value, severity).
data_to_capture: Verification of alarm details in the notification

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification is sent within the specified system response time (URS-EMS-011).
test_steps.expected_result: The time between alarm trigger in EMS and receipt of notification by the paging system is within the 30-second limit.
data_to_capture: Time difference between alarm trigger and notification receipt

test_steps.action: Acknowledge the alarm in the EMS and verify if the acknowledgment is reflected in any associated paging system logs or notifications (if applicable).
test_steps.expected_result: Alarm acknowledgment in EMS is handled correctly and does not interfere with the integration.
data_to_capture: Status of alarm in EMS after acknowledgment

acceptance_criteria: EMS alarms are successfully transmitted to the site paging system.
Alarm notifications contain accurate and relevant information.
Alarm notification delivery meets the specified response time requirement.
data_integrity_requirements: Timely and accurate delivery of critical alarm information is essential for product safety.
urs_requirements: URS-EMS-015: Alarm notifications shall integrate with site paging system using vendor API.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Data Storage Capacity
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System meets the specified availability of 99.5% and has sufficient data storage capacity for a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is fully installed and operational.
Access to system logs and monitoring tools is available.
Documentation detailing system availability metrics and storage capacity is accessible.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 30 days) and calculate the percentage of availability, excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
test_steps.expected_result: The calculated system availability is >= 99.5%.

test_steps.action: Review system configuration and vendor documentation to confirm the data storage capacity and its projected longevity for continuous monitoring.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's data storage capacity is confirmed to support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
data_to_capture: System configuration settings for data storage

acceptance_criteria: System availability is confirmed to be 99.5% or higher.
Data storage capacity is confirmed to support at least 10 years of continuous monitoring.
data_integrity_requirements: Availability data must be accurate and verifiable.
Storage capacity documentation must be current and accurate.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Facility Management System Integration and Alarm Notification
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System successfully interfaces with the existing facility management system via standard protocols and that alarm notifications integrate with the site paging system using the vendor API.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is fully installed and operational.
Facility Management System is operational and accessible.
Site paging system is operational.
Vendor API documentation for alarm notifications is available.
Network connectivity between systems is established.

test_steps.action: Configure the EMS to send temperature and humidity data to the Facility Management System using the specified standard protocols.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature and humidity data from the EMS is successfully received and displayed in the Facility Management System.
data_to_capture: EMS configuration settings for FMS integration
Screenshots of FMS displaying EMS data

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature alarm condition within the EMS that triggers an alert.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm is generated by the EMS.

test_steps.action: Verify that the triggered alarm notification is sent to the site paging system via the vendor API.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm notification is received on the site paging system.

acceptance_criteria: Environmental Monitoring System data is successfully integrated with the Facility Management System.
Alarm notifications are successfully transmitted to the site paging system.
data_integrity_requirements: Data transmitted to FMS must be accurate and complete.
Alarm notifications must be timely and contain accurate information.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Electronic Signature Functionality for Data Modifications
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system enforces electronic signatures for any data modifications as per 21 CFR Part 11.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
A scenario to simulate a data modification is prepared (e.g., adjusting a setpoint or reclassifying an alarm).

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify a system parameter or data point that requires an electronic signature.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts the user for their electronic signature (username and password).
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the electronic signature prompt.

test_steps.action: Provide valid electronic signature credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: The modification is successfully applied and recorded in the audit trail with the electronic signature.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entry showing the modification and electronic signature.

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify the same parameter or data point using invalid electronic signature credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: The modification is rejected, and an error message is displayed.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entry (if any) indicating the failed attempt.

acceptance_criteria: The system correctly prompts for electronic signatures for data modifications.
Valid electronic signatures are accepted, and modifications are recorded.
Invalid electronic signatures are rejected, preventing unauthorized modifications.
data_integrity_requirements: Electronic signatures must be unique and attributable to an individual.
Electronic signatures must be linked to the record being signed.
Audit trails must record all actions performed by users, including electronic signatures.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Archival and Retrieval for Long-Term Storage
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system can archive historical data for 7 years and that this data can be retrieved for review.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists to perform archival.
Archival process is understood and documented.
A method for verifying retrieved data is established.

test_steps.action: Initiate the data archival process for a defined period (e.g., data older than 1 year).
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully archives the specified historical data, and the original data is no longer readily accessible in the active database.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entry for the archival process.

test_steps.action: Attempt to retrieve a sample of the archived data using the vendor's archival feature.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully retrieves the requested archived data.
data_to_capture: Audit trail entry for the retrieval process.

test_steps.action: Verify the integrity and accuracy of the retrieved archived data against a known baseline or original data.
test_steps.expected_result: The retrieved archived data matches the original data in terms of content and format.
data_to_capture: Comparison report of original vs. archived data.

test_steps.action: Verify that the system's archival feature supports the 7-year retention requirement.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's configuration and documentation confirm the capability to retain data for at least 7 years.

acceptance_criteria: Data archival process completes successfully.
Archived data can be retrieved using the vendor's standard functionality.
Retrieved archived data is accurate and maintains its integrity.
The system supports the 7-year data retention requirement.
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must be protected from unauthorized access or modification.
Archived data must be retrievable in a human-readable format.
The archival process must be documented and auditable.
